parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese.

- en-US: English. This is the default value.

parameters.name: AddressPoolId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the address pool.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a token to make sure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.
